exposure: diastolic blood pressure 80 mm Hg or greater
fasting plasma glucose 5.1 mmol/L or greater
weight gain 10 kg or greater in the year before pregnancy
age of menarche 15 years or greater
daily staple food intake 300 g or greater
daily physical activity duration 1 h or greater
cohort: Nulliparous women in early pregnancy who underwent preconception health examinations.
finding: A preconception GDM risk prediction model, incorporating identified risk and protective factors, demonstrated good predictive efficacy for identifying populations at high risk of GDM before pregnancy.
